name: Mire's Edge
description: A frontier settlement built on wooden platforms above the Whispering Marshes. The air reeks of decay and possibility. Smugglers, outcasts, and fortune-seekers all find refuge here—for a price.

inn.name: The Driftwood Rest
inn.description: A ramshackle tavern that tilts slightly to the left. The ale is cheap, the beds cheaper, but the rumors flow freely.

episode_05: The Sunken Temple's been rising from the swamp. Unnatural, that.
Cultists been buying up marsh reed and quicklime. For what, I don't want to know.
Old Garrick says he explored that temple years back. Never talks about what he saw.
episode_06: Orcs under a white flag? Never thought I'd see the day.
The Bloodfang have been quiet lately. Makes me nervous when orcs go quiet.
Urgot's a hard bastard, but he keeps his word. If he swears alliance, he means it.

marsh_blessing.description: Blessing against marsh diseases and poisons (+4 to saves vs disease/poison for 1 week)

harbormaster_garrick.name: Harbormaster Garrick
harbormaster_garrick.description: A weathered man in his fifties with salt-and-pepper hair and scars from a hundred close calls. He's seen things in the marsh that would drive others mad.

dialogue.greeting: Welcome to Mire's Edge. Watch your step—literally. Platforms rot fast in this climate.
dialogue.episode_05_hook: That temple's been trouble since it started rising. Help deal with it, and you'll have the town's gratitude.
dialogue.after_episode_05: You did good work at the temple. Mire's Edge owes you one.

urgot_warchief.name: War-Chief Urgot
urgot_warchief.description: A massive orc with ritualistic scars and iron-gray hair braided with bones. His eyes hold brutal intelligence.

dialogue.greeting: You are the one who hunts the Serpent. Good. We have common enemy.
dialogue.episode_06_proposal: The Serpent has taken our fortress. Fight with us. Prove orcs and humans can be more than enemies.
dialogue.after_alliance: You have my axe, human. When you need the Bloodfang, we come.

widow_marla.name: Widow Marla
widow_marla.description: A sharp-eyed woman who runs the Driftwood Rest. Nothing happens in Mire's Edge without her knowing.

dialogue.greeting: Drink? Information? Both are for sale here.
dialogue.about_smugglers: Smugglers Guild operates out of the eastern platforms. You need an introduction, I can arrange it—for a price.
dialogue.black_market_hint: Looking for items the law frowns upon? Talk to me after you've earned some trust.
